description: This file defines the top-level structure of a curriculum, including enumerations for superblocks, stages, and language mappings, as well as functions to generate and filter superblock lists based on configuration and language.

methods.name: getStageOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of superblock stages, optionally including upcoming stages based on configuration.

methods.name: generateSuperBlockList
methods.description: Generates a list of superblocks based on the current stage order and configuration.

methods.name: getAuditedSuperBlocks
methods.description: Returns the list of superblocks that have been audited for a given language, filtering out not audited superblocks.
